First public release of **Just Simple Planner**, a local visual timeline for Obsidian where every card is an ordinary Markdown note.

- Threads, continuous dates, zoom and filters, independent of note folders.
- Connections by dragging a hover handle, cross-thread flows, direct disconnection and Spotlight.
- Compact title previews for folded threads.
- Drag rescheduling, flow moves, matching grab-to-pan behavior and session undo/redo.
- Markdown entry editor, notebook view and pending-task rail.
- Illustrated guide and twenty fictional Spanish example entries.

## Install

Requires **Obsidian 1.10.2 or later**. Download `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below and place them directly in `<vault>/<config-dir>/plugins/just-simple-planner/` (the default configuration directory is `.obsidian`). Reload Obsidian, enable the plugin and run **Just Simple Planner: Open planner**.

See the [visual guide](https://github.com/DavidHurtadoAI/just-simple-planner#readme) for gestures, note properties and examples.

## Validation and scope

The release passes the official Obsidian ESLint rules with zero warnings, strict TypeScript, model tests and distribution checks. Desktop integration checks run in the dedicated `@Nexus-dev` vault. Physical mobile devices, touch dragging, very large vaults and simultaneous multi-device editing remain untested. The plugin makes no network requests of its own and has no runtime package dependencies.

Inspired by [Haftio](https://www.haftio.com/), with thanks and an apology to its makers for borrowing the idea so quickly. This is an independent implementation; the [README explains the story and the credit](https://github.com/DavidHurtadoAI/just-simple-planner#the-story-and-the-credit).
